name: StandX DUSD
oneLiner: DUSD is StandX's delta-neutral synthetic dollar, redeemable 1:1 against USDT/USDC and backed by hedged BTC/ETH/SOL positions on CEXes via Ceffu custody.
collateral: USDT/USDC deposits converted to hedged crypto positions (BTC, ETH, SOL) via Ceffu
pegMechanism: Delta-neutral hedging on centralized exchanges; 1:1 USDT/USDC redemption

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Possible retained: reviewed metadata indicates direct token, vault, issuer, pause, proxy, or admin-control uncertainty, but available registry sources do not prove an active holder-balance blacklist path.

reserves.name: Spot crypto (BTC/ETH/SOL/BNB, delta-hedged via perp shorts)
Perpetual short futures positions (CEX via Ceffu custody)

mintAuthority.summary: StandX DUSD is minted on-chain via the protocol Gateway when users deposit USDT/USDC into the StandX Secure Vault; the StandX off-chain Settler/backend manages delta-neutral CEX hedges and validates redemption order signatures, with an RSV Fund multisig bridging assets on/off-chain.

controls.label: StandX Gateway / program mint authority (PDA of immutable StandX program on Solana; BSC admin unresolved)

BSC (unresolved): DUSD BSC token 0xaf44... has multi-layer proxy admin — full chain: 0x2c02(proxy→0xdf09)→0x00b4(proxy→0xb69f AccessControl+UUPS). Role holders in BSC AccessControl not enumerable via standard ABI. Docs describe Gateway contract minting on collateral deposit with 7-day redemption lock.

controls.label: StandX Settler / backend + RSV Fund multisig
controls.evidence: The Settler manages delta-neutral positions across CEXes and the RSV Fund multisig bridges assets between on-chain and off-chain platforms; StandX can reject redemption orders, making the issuer backend a controlling party over the mint/redeem lifecycle.

review.evidence: StandX operates a two-layer model (on-chain Gateway + off-chain Settler/RSV multisig). Solana: at slot 425778638, DUSD mint DUSDt4AeLZHWYmcXnVGYdgAzjtzU5mXUVnTMdnSzAttM (Token-2022) has mintAuthority and freezeAuthority H4Mp7WL282pdbY9V9N7AJnsQwB5yyrU1E7svfsH2Ur5h, which is owned by StandX program STANDKqqZERMKosYH2PAtNtnt6mig4CRPycsRwjuVhB. StandX program has upgradeAuthority: None (immutable, programData 4XNF9sPKbX3SAor8mm8HDbWycw7qGC642NJs6mePqXQe at slot 425779135). Solana mint authority is a PDA of an immutable program. BSC: DUSD token 0xaf44a1e76f56ee12adbb7ba8acd3cbd474888122 has slot 0 = 0x2c02f575cdd0cc87de89ae6a493b05a5ed95065a (admin proxy pointing to implementation 0xdf09ebf9a24080deedb0a9a85db0b3aa9a90caa1); slot 1 of that proxy = 0x00b4f9b510893505acefb10ec91cbc972185088e (a second proxy pointing to 0xb69f4f80ec472ff9fe86933ac739329f8f72dc3b, a 31KB AccessControl+UUPS implementation). Actual admin role holders in the BSC AccessControl contract cannot be enumerated — non-enumerable AccessControl with all ABI calls reverting through the proxy.
unresolvedQuestions: BSC: BSC admin chain 0xaf44→slot0→0x2c02(proxy→0xdf09)→slot1→0x00b4(proxy→0xb69f AccessControl+UUPS); non-enumerable AccessControl means actual DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and MINTER_ROLE holders cannot be read via standard ABI calls. Identify role holders via event logs (RoleGranted events) or issuer disclosure before raising confidence.
